config.train_max_k_note: D8 code (#221 on agent-main): K cap of the training items only (train.run_cell.train_max_k; cell_items default, also used by the m2_gates lineage rebuild); max_k 16 remains the eval cap (train.m2_gates.unit_spec, run_cell eval_items). B1 100k-v2 carries rows with > 16 options (BANKING77 77-option catalogs, Glaive catalog views K 17-27), which max_k 16 alone would drop.
config.row_options_note: execution guard (train.trainer.row_groups / single_cont_fits): <= 160 forked continuations per backbone call; a row with K > 160 runs alone, and a step whose summed K exceeds 160 runs per group under cont_plan single. Worst call = 8,192 prefix tokens + 160 copies ~= 53.8 GB (tvuat ladder 1,024 rung) + 80 x <= 87 MB ~= 61 GB < 76 GB stop (D8 sizing). Not in the TrainConfig hash; never binds on K <= 16 steps (8 x 16 = 128).
config.anti_collapse_note: train/trainer.py TrainConfig anti-collapse fields; each absent key = the old behaviour. lr_schedule and collapse_* are in the config hash; dev_card_* and best_ckpt are operational. Each dev card scores 200 rows (budget it inside max_minutes).
config.execution_note: row_batch 1: one row per backbone call (8 rows / optimiser step via grad_accum 8); act_ckpt true (heads/act_ckpt.py covers Qwen3.5 decoders); the cache fork reads each row's prompt once and forks its K continuations. row_plan / cont_plan / row_options only act with row_batch > 1 (train/trainer.py). The clock binds (max_steps 20,000).
config.v3w_note: generic v3w (decide/v3w_generic.py, PINNED_SPEC_SHA256 'jrt-v3w-generic:qwen3.5' 2e4907ee...; 255 single-token codes after the Qwen answer prefix, word ids by unique first token, Qwen3.5 chat template with enable_thinking=False -> empty think block, budget 16,383). config.shim_note: template jrt-h2o-shim:qwen3.5-4b (decide/shim_format.py, pinned identity): the vendored, unmodified H2O-Lightning-4B v1.1 shim prompt (third_party/h2o_lightning_shim, the host scan's replica that matched H2O's card 205/231): Qwen chat turn, thinking off, the shim system text, 'record: / question: / options: A) name: desc', 'Answer:' prefill; option k = shim label k (A, B, ...), its continuation the ONE token of ' <label>' (the shim's own probe); bound to the snapshot's tokenizer files, any other tokenizer fails closed. Train rows == the shim prompt ids (and == transformers' whole-string tokenization = vLLM /tokenize): scripts/check_sizecliff_cpu.py.
config.budget_note: A-PREREG-JEV3-LM: worst case $17.89 <= $18 (<= $15 is not reachable for 1 epoch: the screen cap 44 is the setup preflight's, so a 89-min job leaves ~20 training minutes)
config.sym_reprice_note: Clock re-price (CPU 2026-10-10, real Qwen3.5-4B tokenizer, systematic 1-in-24 sample of bschema-draw-jev1 = 4,000 items, all kept by train.run_cell.keep_item under both layouts; K mean 4.78, max 16): tokens the backbone RUNS per row (prefix + continuation calls right-padded per cont_chunk 64 chunk, MIN_CONT_WIDTH 2) g1v2 368.1 vs sym-fork 362.7, factor 0.985 (fed tokens without padding 363.3 vs 352.1, 0.969): the options move from the prefix into the continuations, about token-neutral. Projected 10.92 x 0.985 = 10.76 s/step -> ceil(1,121 x 10.76 x 1.3 / 60) = 262 min; max_minutes stays 270 (the measured g1v2 budget; the factor is a token model, not a measurement: the step-10 rate check (exit 26) re-measures it in-job). Script: scripts/sym_reprice_jev1.py 24 (receipt in docs/PROOF_INVARIANCE.md).
config.max_len_note: public long_policy items are 2,350-3,952 tokens (r2 preds usage.input_tokens) vs jev1 long_policy train rows p50 935 / max 1,263 (build-report): the trained head never saw > 2k contexts. 4,096 for training (t_ladder top rung; require_t_max fails closed instead of silently dropping rows > T_max) and eval. Memory at 4k on H100 80 GB (4B, act_ckpt): the attention-layer KV copy per forked option grows ~0.7 GB at T 1,020 (cf3929b) -> ~2.8 GB at 4,096; long_policy rows carry K 4-6 -> <= ~17 GB of copies + ~8 GB weights + checkpointed activations; the cont_chunk probe (4b0fb1d) re-picks the chunk over the worst K x T rows <= 4,096 (candidates 8..64, peak <= 0.85 x 76 GB) and ladder_probe_longest steps the LONGEST rows of each rung (the max-K rung rows are short), so 4k is measured before training.
config.label_smoothing_note: yes/no (noul) rows: eps 0 (sharp targets). jevkit scores a noul answer with p in (0.2, 0.8) as WRONG; r2 put 10/74 noul items in that band (stock 0), the whole argmax-vs-jevkit gap (claude/ev-j1-rescore @a8ca3e7e), and smoothing pulls yes/no answers toward 0.5. choice / score rows: eps 0.05 (was the clef default 0.1 on every row; r2's head was under-confident, shim T 0.8 raised its Capability 57.93 -> 59.62). Per-row eps by question type (train.losses.arm_loss already receives qtypes).
config.noul_band_gate: reported gate: the native arm's yes/no 0.2-0.8 band rate on the 231 items <= stock_shim's (screen.jevkit_report noul_band_gate); the calib-slice band rate at T = 1 and at the fitted T are reported, and T is moved toward 1 if it would raise the slice band rate (constrain_t_by_band)
config.assert_no_truncation_note: fail closed (run_cell exit 25 'data') if ANY drawn training question is dropped by the K / T filter at tokenization or by the measured T_max; jev2c has 1,448 / 1,500 rows > 2,048 tokens (max 3,347), all inside 4,096. The screen fails (9) if any JevBench item is refused for input length (jevkit.assert_no_truncation).

config.layout_note: decide.canon_shim: inference rows (g1v2-canon) render every choice option in the canonical order (NFC + whitespace-collapse + casefold key, sha256 tie-break), lettered A, B, ... in that order, ids never rendered (names 001..K), mapped back outside the model; noul (true, false); score = 'level v of K: <rubric>' in level order. TRAINING rows (train_layout g1v2-canon-shuffle): choice options in a seeded random order (seed = the row's content hash; one shuffle per row, 1 epoch), so the model learns no canonical-letter prior (evidence claude/ev-canonical-prior @1ccdc676: canonical train gold = A 35% vs 28% chance); score / noul as at inference
config.lr_horizon_steps_note: Amendment 2: the cosine horizon is the step budget N = 200 (warmup 50 steps to the peak LR, then cosine to 0.1 x at step 200), fixed before the first step; NOT a truncated 729-step schedule

cohort_v3_excluded.rule: id OR normalized content OR source item OR key-free text held out by the cohort (train.cohort_v3)

attack_guard.rule: attack_guard/v2: concatenated record text + base64 decodes; 6-gram or exact (4-5 word) fragment, whole-template wildcard (placeholder = 1..30 words, >= 4 fixed words), or fuzzy >= 0.5 of fixed word 3-grams (>= 3); NFKC, Cf removed, Cyrillic+Greek homoglyphs folded, casefold

doc_overlap_guard.rule: doc_overlap_guard/v1: 13-gram (attack_guard.normalise, no leaf crossing) row document vs Index eval units (DEV+TEST+held-out); FAIL if covered >= 0.5 of the row's grams (R) or of an eval unit's grams (E), or the draw covers >= 0.5 of a unit and the row >= 0.25 of it (U); min 3 covered grams, (E)/(U) units >= 5 grams; boilerplate = eval df > 1% AND train df > 1%, or both df >= 10, or eval df >= 100 (templates), excluded from instruction/option units only, never from state units; allowlist entries never apply to rows of the eval family own source; R denominator drops allowlisted grams, R needs >= 3 covered; reviewed allowlist of shared public corpora; units over 256-unit df skip (E)/(U)
